IDENTITY_QUERY: I am AlienApe, your local AI agent and controller for models, tools, and project tasks.
DELETE_REQUEST_UNSUPPORTED: Deleting files is not currently supported. Nothing was changed.
PERMISSION_ACTION: Action: {operation}\nSession approval applies only to this action and exactly this path.
MEMORY_SENSITIVE_REJECTED: I do not store sensitive credentials in normal memory.
CAPABILITY_SCOPE: Global capability: the tools can create files and folders; the current task may be read-only.
CAPABILITY_LIMIT: No deletion tool, general shell, or unrestricted network access.
MISSING_TARGET_PATH: What should the file be called? Please provide one unambiguous relative path.
AMBIGUOUS_TARGET: Please provide exactly one unambiguous relative target path.
MISSING_CONTENT_MODE: What should the file contain: empty, explicitly supplied text, or generated content?
MISSING_MUTATION: Should I actually create this file? Please explicitly provide the target and content.
MISSING_ARTIFACT: No unambiguous immediately preceding artifact is available. Please provide the content to save.
DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE: Directory creation is unavailable: the controller has no tool for it. No directory was created.
MODEL_STATUS:
Routing: {mode}.
Selected model: {selected}.
Last worker: {worker}.
Semantic resolver: {semantic}.
NO_WORKER: no worker in this session yet
MEMORY_DISABLED: Memory is disabled. Enable it in settings.
PERMISSION_WRITE_HEADING: The agent wants to create or replace a file.
PERMISSION_DIRECTORY_HEADING: The agent wants to create a directory.
PERMISSION_VERIFY_HEADING: Run project code for verification. Tests or Godot can have side effects.
PERMISSION_PREVIEW: Complete new file content (replaces existing content):
PERMISSION_ABORT: STOP in the main window or Escape cancels the action.
VERIFICATION_CPP_NOT_RUN: Code verification: NOT_RUN — no supported syntax or runtime verifier is available for this language. A write confirmation does not verify correctness.
SENSITIVE_FILE_WARNING: Sensitive file: only redacted structure is shown; no secret values.
DIRECTORY_LIST_HEADER: Files in the current project folder:
DIRECTORY_LIST_TRUNCATED: [Bounded file list; additional entries may exist.]
MEMORY_SECRET_REFERENCE: Credentials are not stored in project memory. Use a provider secret reference.
ANALYSIS_SCOPE_FOOTER: Analysis scope: {paths}. A bounded selection of files was examined; this is not a complete project review.
MEMORY_OVERVIEW_DISABLED: Project memory is disabled. You can enable it in settings.
MEMORY_OVERVIEW_EMPTY: No active information is stored for this project. Use “Remember: …” to add something.
MEMORY_OVERVIEW_HEADER: The following is stored for this project:
MEMORY_OVERVIEW_FULL: Find the full content in the Memory tab under View / Edit.
UI_INPUT_HINT: What would you like to do in the project?
SERVER_CONNECT_ERROR: Cannot reach the model server. Start Ollama or the local LM Studio server and check the URL and port.
SERVER_TIMEOUT_ERROR: The model server timed out. Check whether the model is loaded.
SERVER_HTTP_ERROR: The model server returned HTTP {status}. Check the model, context size, API key and tool support. See the activity log for details.
MEMORY_FORGET_DISABLED: Memory is disabled. Nothing was deleted.
MEMORY_FORGET_UNCLEAR: No unique matching memory was found. Please clarify; nothing was deleted.
PROJECT_NAME_REQUIRED: What should the new project folder be called?
PROJECT_ROOT_INVALID: Please provide a safe relative project name without a path. Nothing was changed.
PROJECT_ROOT_EXISTS: The project folder already contains files. Existing-project modification is not supported yet.
PROJECT_PLAN_INVALID: The project plan or path is invalid. No project was started.
PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE: Safe planning is not yet available for this project request. Nothing was changed.
PROJECT_INTERRUPTED: Project execution was interrupted. Files already created may remain; inspect the project folder.
UI_FILES_TIP: Double-click to put a read request in the input field.
UI_RESOURCES: Resources: no task has run yet
UI_CLEAR_TIP: Clear chat and current approvals. SQLite Memory is kept.
UI_INPUT_TIP: Ctrl+Enter sends. Enter adds a new line.
UI_STOP_TIP: Cancel the current request and further tools · Escape
UI_SHORTCUT: Ctrl+Enter to send · Esc to cancel
UI_MEMORY_NOTE: Explicit project information · editable · saved between sessions
UI_ACTIVITY_NOTE: Observable actions and results · no hidden model thoughts
UI_DIAGNOSTIC_LAST_TIP: Only the latest recorded task; no retroactive recording.
UI_SETTINGS_RESTART: The language setting was saved. Restart AlienApe to apply it throughout the interface.
UI_LANGUAGE_RESTART_REQUIRED: The language will be fully applied after restart.
DIALOG_PROVIDER_MANAGED: Edit the provider and server under Manage models.
DIALOG_DIAGNOSTIC_TIP: Optional: save a redacted diagnostic per task locally. Off by default.
DIALOG_SETTINGS_NOTE:
Local servers only. Models are queried after saving.
Provider secrets use secret references in the model profile. The context budget limits messages; tool definitions and model responses add to it.
DIALOG_MEMORY_KEY_TIP: Using the same key replaces the previous decision.
DIALOG_MEMORY_MISSING: Enter both a key and content.
UI_SEMANTIC_CONFIGURED: Semantic Intent Resolver: configured; availability is checked when needed
UI_SEMANTIC_NOT_AVAILABLE: Semantic resolver model is not available.
COMMUNITY_EXPORT_NOTE: Review and generalize the description. Prompts, answers, file contents, local paths, and endpoints are not exported. The card remains UNVERIFIED.
COMMUNITY_PREVIEW: The privacy-checked export preview appears here.
COMMUNITY_CONFIRM: I reviewed the preview and confirm exporting this card.
COMMUNITY_SAVED: The Community Card was saved. Import remains a separate, manual step.
COMMUNITY_IMPORT_SUCCESS: Card imported and stored as UNVERIFIED.
COMMUNITY_PANEL_NOTE: Offline exchange of individual, locally observed results. Imported cards are UNVERIFIED, do not change local Experience, and do not affect model selection.
COMMUNITY_LOCAL_ROWS: Local observations · export one at a time after review
COMMUNITY_SELECT_CARD: Select an imported card to inspect its fields.
SEMANTIC_SAVED_VALUES: Saved when opened: similarity {similarity} · margin {margin} · timeout {timeout} s
SEMANTIC_CONFIGURED: Configured · availability is checked when needed
SEMANTIC_NOT_CONFIGURED: No model configured · nothing will be downloaded
SEMANTIC_MODEL_AVAILABLE: The configured model reports embedding support
SEMANTIC_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: Semantic resolver model is unavailable. Select an installed embedding model.
